title: Binary search variants and the effects of batching
manipulation: Batched, prefetched Eytzinger with eight threads.
held_constants: Ryzen 4750U, 1.7GHz, turbo/SMT disabled; Rust; same benchmark setup.
observable: Amortized query time, five repeats, medians and spread.
coder_inference: Close experimental comparison, but authors report near parity rather than a retained throughput advantage.
uncertainty: Different implementation with batching (Eytzinger 16, binary search 32); not the identical implementation in C1. Original blog, not established peer review. Underlying data/code not independently verified.
